name: ballmonster
description: BALL.MONSTER is a Pokémon type effectiveness calculator with support for all generations. Play around to find the type info you're seeking.

scripts.dev: node esbuild.dev.js && concurrently -n "SASS,ESBUILD,PREPROCESS,DEV" -c "magenta,yellow,blue,cyan" "sass --watch src/scss/index.scss:dist/index.css" "node esbuild.watch.js" "cd server/preprocess && BASE_PATH=../../dist air" "cd server/dev && air"

author: Grant Schussler
